description.value:
In 2046, footage leaked of an Arasaka Security sniper neutralizing a trio of armored terrorists during a political event in Paris in a grand total of 9 seconds. Four years later, the Aka-Ashi was made public. It immediately earned a reputation for extreme precision, reliability, and sheer lethality. Yet, its steep entry cost has barred anyone except deep-pocketed fans and corporate security from possessing it, especially after the SOR-22’s release (at half the cost).

Cost: 7,500eb (Super Luxury)

Class: EQ Sniper Rifle • Skill: Shoulder Arms • Range: Marksman Rifle

Damage: 6d6 • Capacity: 5 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: 0 • Attachments: Bipod, Headtoll, Power Rebuild, Smartgun Link, Sniper Rifle Rechamber, Sniping Scope • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only load modified High Precision Ammunition (500eb (Expensive) per 10) which also functions as Armor-Piercing Ammunition. Damage from this weapon ignores armor entirely if it is lower than SP 9. Armor with a higher SP is still interacted with as normal. When using this weapon to make an Aimed Shot, it deals 1d6 additional damage (7d6) [Headtoll]. Requires BODY 10+ or being Mounted to wield.

Range: Marksman Rifle
Pre-installed: Bipod, Headtoll, Power Rebuild, Smartgun Link, Sniper Rifle Rechamber, Sniping Scope (effects already included in these stats)

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
